By prioritizing high-visibility legislative changes, the government uses a pretext of community safety to avoid the strain of managing failing child safety infrastructure.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. The focus on optics over systemic care creates a net negative.

The Unavoidable Truth: Children in state care are currently sleeping on floors.

The Unavoidable Lie: Legislative bail reform is the priority over immediate child welfare.
